tasks.title: Stepwise Layout Refactor for Improved Modularity
tasks.description: Implement a 5-step gradual refactor to improve layout modularity and UI consistency by extracting components and reorganizing the layout structure while maintaining functionality.
tasks.details:
Execute a careful stepwise refactor to improve modularity without breaking existing functionality:

**Step 1: Extract Phase Tracker to GameLayout**
- Create GameLayout.tsx component that wraps all phase screens
- Extract only the phase tracker (Run #, Round #) into persistent header
- Keep all existing screen content and control panels unchanged in their current locations
- Ensure GameLayout provides consistent wrapper structure

**Step 2: Extract Combat Control Panel Component**
- Create CombatControlPanel.tsx component for combat phase controls
- Move combat-specific controls (attack buttons, abilities) into separate component
- Keep component rendered within CombatScreen to maintain current layout
- Ensure all state management and event handlers remain local to combat screen

**Step 3: Gradually Move Control Panels to Layout**
- Modify GameLayout to include dedicated control panel area (bottom-left)
- Move combat control panel into layout structure, passing state/handlers as props
- Repeat process for shop and other phase control panels one at a time
- Maintain backward compatibility during transition

**Step 4: Move Combat Log to Layout**
- Extract combat log into shared layout component
- Ensure combat log receives proper state updates from combat system
- Position log in consistent location across all phases
- Maintain log persistence and proper state management

**Step 5: Center Non-Combat Screens and Polish**
- Center shop, death, and lab screens within main content area
- Apply consistent spacing and alignment across all phases
- Polish layout transitions and ensure responsive behavior
- Add final styling touches for professional appearance

Component structure:
```tsx
interface GameLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  currentPhase: GamePhase;
  runNumber: number;
  roundNumber: number;
  controlPanel?: React.ReactNode;
  combatLog?: CombatLogEntry[];
}
```
tasks.testStrategy: Verify each step independently before proceeding to next step. Test that phase tracker remains persistent and updates correctly across all phases. Confirm control panels maintain full functionality when extracted and moved. Verify combat log displays correctly and receives proper state updates. Test that non-combat screens are properly centered and responsive. Conduct full game loop testing after each step to ensure no functionality is broken. Verify layout remains stable during phase transitions and maintains consistent appearance across all screen sizes.

tasks.title: Deploy Prototype to Web with Production Pipeline
tasks.description: Set up a production deployment pipeline and deploy the game prototype to a web hosting platform, making it publicly accessible for testing and feedback.
tasks.details:
Implement a complete deployment pipeline for the game prototype:

**Platform Selection and Setup:**
- Choose deployment platform (Vercel recommended for React/TypeScript projects)
- Create account and connect GitHub repository
- Configure automatic deployments from main branch

**Production Build Configuration:**
- Ensure package.json has proper build scripts
- Configure environment variables for production
- Optimize build settings for performance (code splitting, minification)
- Set up proper TypeScript compilation for production
- Configure asset optimization and compression

**Deployment Pipeline Setup:**
- Set up continuous deployment from GitHub repository
- Configure build commands and output directory
- Set up preview deployments for pull requests
- Configure custom domain if needed
- Set up SSL certificate (automatic with most platforms)

**Production Readiness Checklist:**
- Remove development-only code and console logs
- Ensure all dependencies are properly listed in package.json
- Configure proper error boundaries for production
- Set up basic analytics or monitoring
- Test build locally before deployment
- Verify all game phases work in production build

**Post-Deployment Setup:**
- Configure custom 404 page if needed
- Set up basic SEO meta tags
- Test deployment across different browsers and devices
- Document deployment process and URL sharing
tasks.testStrategy: Verify successful deployment by testing the public URL across multiple browsers and devices, confirm all game phases (Combat, Shop, Death, Lab) function correctly in the production environment, test the complete game loop end-to-end on the deployed version, verify automatic deployments trigger correctly when pushing to main branch, and ensure the site loads quickly and handles errors gracefully. Share the URL with team members to confirm external accessibility and gather initial feedback on performance and functionality.

tasks.title: Review and Prioritize Progression System Epic Tasks
tasks.description: Conduct a comprehensive review of all tasks tagged with 'progression-epic' to assess current status, identify blockers, and create a prioritized roadmap for the next development phase.
tasks.details:
Perform a thorough analysis of the progression system epic to prepare for the next development phase:

**Epic Review Process:**
- Audit all tasks currently tagged with 'progression-epic' in the project management system
- Categorize tasks by status: completed, in-progress, blocked, and pending
- Identify task dependencies and critical path items within the progression epic
- Assess resource requirements and estimated effort for each remaining task

**Gap Analysis and Planning:**
- Review existing progression system requirements and identify any missing functionality
- Evaluate current game state management to determine integration points for progression features
- Identify potential conflicts or dependencies with recently completed tasks (Tasks 12-16)
- Document any new tasks that need to be created to complete the progression system

**Prioritization Framework:**
- Rank tasks by business value and player impact
- Consider technical dependencies and implementation complexity
- Factor in current team capacity and sprint planning constraints
- Create a recommended implementation sequence with clear milestones

**Deliverables:**
- Updated task status report for all progression-epic tagged items
- Prioritized backlog with recommended sprint assignments
- Risk assessment and mitigation strategies for high-priority items
- Updated epic timeline with realistic completion estimates
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the review is comprehensive by confirming all progression-epic tagged tasks are accounted for and properly categorized. Validate prioritization logic by cross-referencing with product requirements and technical constraints. Test the proposed implementation sequence by checking that all dependencies are properly ordered and no circular dependencies exist. Confirm the timeline estimates are realistic by comparing against historical velocity data and team capacity.

tasks.title: Stepwise Layout Refactor for Improved Modularity
tasks.description: Implement a 5-step gradual refactor to improve layout modularity and UI consistency by extracting components and reorganizing the layout structure while maintaining functionality.
tasks.details:
Execute a careful stepwise refactor to improve modularity without breaking existing functionality:

**Step 1: Extract Phase Tracker to GameLayout**
- Create GameLayout.tsx component that wraps all phase screens
- Extract only the phase tracker (Run #, Round #) into persistent header
- Keep all existing screen content and control panels unchanged in their current locations
- Ensure GameLayout provides consistent wrapper structure

**Step 2: Extract Combat Control Panel Component**
- Create CombatControlPanel.tsx component for combat phase controls
- Move combat-specific controls (attack buttons, abilities) into separate component
- Keep component rendered within CombatScreen to maintain current layout
- Ensure all state management and event handlers remain local to combat screen

**Step 3: Gradually Move Control Panels to Layout**
- Modify GameLayout to include dedicated control panel area (bottom-left)
- Move combat control panel into layout structure, passing state/handlers as props
- Repeat process for shop and other phase control panels one at a time
- Maintain backward compatibility during transition

**Step 4: Move Combat Log to Layout**
- Extract combat log into shared layout component
- Ensure combat log receives proper state updates from combat system
- Position log in consistent location across all phases
- Maintain log persistence and proper state management

**Step 5: Center Non-Combat Screens and Polish**
- Center shop, death, and lab screens within main content area
- Apply consistent spacing and alignment across all phases
- Polish layout transitions and ensure responsive behavior
- Add final styling touches for professional appearance

Component structure:
```tsx
interface GameLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  currentPhase: GamePhase;
  runNumber: number;
  roundNumber: number;
  controlPanel?: React.ReactNode;
  combatLog?: CombatLogEntry[];
}
```
tasks.testStrategy: Verify each step independently before proceeding to next step. Test that phase tracker remains persistent and updates correctly across all phases. Confirm control panels maintain full functionality when extracted and moved. Verify combat log displays correctly and receives proper state updates. Test that non-combat screens are properly centered and responsive. Conduct full game loop testing after each step to ensure no functionality is broken. Verify layout remains stable during phase transitions and maintains consistent appearance across all screen sizes.
